name: tree-public-linsky-geometry-conjunction
hypothesis: When worst fragment deviation exceeds 2.0, replace the energy/core mean with their product; elsewhere retain the mean. Questionable backbone compatibility makes agreement of favorable energy AND core burial more important than compensation between them. Products of normalized [0,1] scores never exceed their mean, so this branch is a conservative demotion while retaining ranking within it. Reuse the same cutoff without tuning.
